verdict.rationale: Superhuman ships an official, first-party "Superhuman Mail MCP" that connects the inbox and calendar to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants. Through it an agent can summarize, draft, send and schedule, and use Superhuman-specific actions such as Split Inbox, Read Statuses, Smart Send and Ask AI, with send approval gating. A probe confirms the documented MCP page exists. Missing for 10: setup, auth and transport documentation for connecting the server, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP integration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.
You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools.
You can also do things that are uniquely Superhuman: triage by Split Inbox, track sent emails, check Read Statuses, Smart Send, and Ask AI.
